card.name: Digits inside section cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits inside bracketed section numbers, such as Contraindications (4) or Description (11), and in some other numbers like years and counts. Also the word Change in repeated WordPress comment login text.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit in the parenthesized section number of a label cross-reference like [see Contraindications (4)].
